extracted.name: Best Moist Banana Bread
extracted.description: This Best Moist Banana Bread is a classic, irresistibly tender loaf packed with ripe banana flavor and a perfectly soft crumb. Made with mashed overripe bananas, butter, sugar, and a hint of vanilla, this banana bread stays moist and flavorful with every slice. Optional add-ins like chopped nuts or chocolate chips bring extra texture and richness. Ideal for breakfast, snack, or dessert, it’s simple to make and guaranteed to satisfy your sweet tooth with comforting, homemade goodness.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted and slightly cooled
3/4 cup brown sugar (packed; or use white sugar for a lighter loaf)
1/2 cup sour cream or plain yogurt (for maximum moisture!)
3 very ripe bananas, mashed (about 1 ¼ to 1 ½ cups)
1/2 cup chopped walnuts or chocolate chips (optional)
instruction_lines: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan or line it with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon (if using) then set aside. In a large mixing bowl whisk the melted butter and brown sugar until smooth, add the eggs and vanilla extract and mix until fully combined, stir in the sour cream (or yogurt), then add the mashed bananas.

Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture. Gently fold the batter together using a spatula or spoon. Do not overmix—stop when just combined. Fold in nuts or chocolate chips if using. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Bake for 50–60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs.
Let the banana bread cool in the pan for about 10–15 minutes, then transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.
